seo.description: DiArsanima (DiA), multidisciplinary visual artist from Maribor: painting, digital art and murals.

blocks.heading: About Artist
blocks.lead: Welcome to the artistic landscape of DiArsanima!

blocks.body: DiArsanima, or *DiA*, is a multidisciplinary visual artist building a collection of archetypes through traditional and digital methods. Her portraits of imagined and real women carry symbols drawn from ancestry, ritual and myth, set in contemporary life.

blocks.heading: Fields of work
blocks.body:
- Classical old and new master techniques in oils, acrylics and mixed media
- Digital art, graphic design and illustration
- Large-scale work: murals, interior and exterior wall paintings

blocks.heading: Education
blocks.body:
- BA in Industrial Design, Academy of Fine Arts and Design, University of Ljubljana
- BA and MA in Painting, Academy of Fine Arts and Design, University of Ljubljana
- Winchester School of Art, United Kingdom
- Faculty of Fine Arts, Lisbon, Portugal
- Balinese painting community, Pengosekan, Indonesia
- Angel Art Academy, Florence, Italy
- Pedagogy and andragogy, Faculty of Education, University of Maribor
